The best businesses know their customers deeply – not just who they are today, but who they'll become. Voyantis is the AI decisioning platform that transforms your customer data into something you can act on. It’s the intelligence that changes how you invest, how you engage, and how you win. The principles that drive us Precision Precision isn't just accuracy - it’s confidence. We help businesses see their best customers clearly, act decisively, and invest with conviction. That’s what predictive intelligence unlocks. Focus Building world-class predictive AI takes years of infrastructure work and rare expertise. We’ve done it so you can focus on growing your business and serving your customers. Impact Our signals cut through the noise to focus on metrics that predict real impact: lifetime value, retention likelihood, revenue potential. The kind of intelligence that changes how you invest and grow. Momentum The best outcomes happen through collaboration. We work alongside your team to turn predictive intelligence into real business momentum. ABOUT VOYANTIS The minds behind the mission We’re growth and ML veterans who have built solutions at Google, Meta, and beyond. We know how these platforms learn because we’ve worked under the hood. Today, we’re partnering with the world’s best growth, marketing, and data teams to build the future of predictive intelligence. Ido Wiesenberg CEO | Co-founder Ido is a seasoned entrepreneur and tech executive with a 20-year track record in TV, media, advertising, and OTT. He co-founded Voyantis after establishing Tvinci, an OTT provider, leading its sales to acquisition by Kaltura. Prior, Ido launched Frido Communication, a digital marketing boutique and held Creative Director positions at renowned agencies like Tribal DDB and Grey Interactive. Forbes listed him among Israel's top young entrepreneurs. He earned a BA in Economics and Philosophy from Tel Aviv University. Eran Friendinger CPO | Co-founder Eran brings a wealth of technical expertise, as a seasoned entrepreneur with over two decades in the tech space. In 2013, Eran co-founded Adience, later acquired by MarketTech, a groundbreaking AI platform for audience segmentation on web and mobile, pioneering the space of audience profiling, based on advanced Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms. Eran holds a Master of Science (M.Sc.) degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, an MBA, and a Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) degree in Computer Engineering from Tel Aviv University. Tzahi Zilbershtein CTO Tzahi Zilbershtein is CTO at Voyantis. He brings 20+ years of experience leading engineering teams to solve business problems and drive AI innovation from research to production. Previously, Tzahi led solution engineering for Google Ads in the EMEA region, delivering custom technical solutions for the platform's largest advertisers. During his tenure, he pioneered the integration of first-party data into Google Ads to optimize marketing budgets, establishing the foundation for predictive LTV optimization that major brands rely on today. Before Google, Tzahi served as VP of R&D at InSoundz. He holds five patents, including two in Google's adtech stack. Peleg Israeli CRO Peleg is a Business executive with a proven track record of success in Performance Marketing and Creative Technology sectors. He has years of extensive, global experience and excels at driving growth spanning from start-ups to large tech companies (Ex-Meta). Peleg is skilled in leading Sales and Creative teams to deliver growth through innovative solutions and is passionate about leveraging creativity and artificial intelligence to propel business growth. Oded Porath COO Oded is COO at Voyantis. He has many years of experience in management roles within startups, with a focus on operations and strategy. Over the past eight years, he worked at Bizzabo as Senior Vice President of Strategy and Operations. Prior to that, he served as an Engagement Manager at McKinsey in New York and as a Marketing Manager at Procter & Gamble. Oded is a board member at the 1907 Fund, which provides tools and resources to brain health scientists to identify causes of psychiatric and neurodegenerative diseases. Additionally, he was a co-founder of ScaleUp NY, an organization that brought together operations managers from Israeli startups operating in New York and held meetings on various aspects of accelerating business growth. Oded holds a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems Engineering from the Technion and an MBA from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania. Ido Azriel VP Product Ido brings 20 years of experience driving product strategy and execution—from early validation to global scale. He's recognized for owning product, technology, and go-to-market end to end to deliver ambitious business outcomes.
